description: This file defines functions related to tensor dimension reordering, including handling of first-class dimensions, flattening, and positional indexing, within the functorch library.

methods.name: _wrap_dim
methods.description: Converts various dimension representations to a DimEntry object, handling None, Dim, and int types.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Reorders tensor dimensions or creates a tensor from specified dimensions, supporting flattening and positional indexing.
